buildCommand: set -e; R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); pnpm --filter @hotzonex/web build; SRC="$R/apps/web/dist"; DEST="$(pwd)/dist"; if [ "$SRC" != "$DEST" ]; then rm -rf "$DEST"; cp -r "$SRC" "$DEST"; fi; ls "$DEST/index.html"

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
